description: Java class defining a rule engine node for making REST API calls in Thingsboard, including configuration, message processing, and upgrade logic.

classes.name: TbRestApiCallNode
classes.description: A rule node for invoking REST API calls, handling message processing, configuration upgrades, and resource management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration and shared event loop.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Processes incoming messages by invoking REST API via httpClient.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroying the httpClient if initialized.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles configuration upgrades from older versions, modifying configuration JSON as needed.
